description: Wall-clock seconds for every reproduce command in ARTIFACT.md, measured one at a time on the paper's machine with a warm model cache. Commands that took under one second are recorded as 0 and printed as '<1' in the paper.
note: module-amplification needs the lora extra and a cached bert-base-uncased. Two entries time a smaller configuration than the one the paper reports; see configuration_caveats. The two known-bias-control runs of adaptive-boundary are variants of the timed command, not separate entries; the four-precision one takes about 2 h 09 min.

configuration_caveats.adaptive-boundary: Times the default command, which sweeps six request precisions with the amplification and fixed-boundary attackers only. The joint (boundary, scale) search of Section S11 uses the same entry point and takes 5120 s (1 h 25 m) on the same machine, because it enumerates the attacker's admissible scales at every bisection step. Table 7 is results/adaptive_boundary_unknownbias/; its step counts come from results/adaptive_boundary_unknownbias_steps/.
configuration_caveats.trained-adapter-defense: Times the command with the default three seeds. The paper reports the ten-seed run in results/trained_adapter_defense_10seed/, which takes about ten times as long, since training the victim adapter dominates.

paper_run_seconds._note: Measured wall-clock for a run the paper reports where it differs from the timed default command. A second execution of the joint-grid command matched all 480 committed rows bit for bit.
